facts.fact: The Conseil National de l'Éducation's seminar of 20-21 July 2026 addressed two Educmaster recommendations to the Ministry of Secondary Education: to add reliable data on learners with special needs to the platform, and to follow up the exhaustive recording of girls' enrolment in Educmaster by heads of establishments; it names no Educmaster action for the primary ministry.

The government's account of the 20-21 July 2026 seminar says girls' enrolment is recorded in Educmaster by heads of secondary establishments, and recommends following up that the recording is exhaustive; it gives no count of establishments and does not mention attendance or results.

systems.tiers: secondary establishments, entered by heads of establishments

note: Class rests on one phrase: enrolment ('effectifs des filles') recorded in Educmaster by school heads; the document does not say whether that is a record per learner or a count, and both statements are recommendations, not reports of completed work.
